//: The documentation section: which pages belong to it, in which order, under which headings, and the words the layout around them needs. This file is the only place a page joins the documentation. A page listed here is rendered with the documentation menu, the list of its own headings and the links to the previous and next page, in every language of `languages` - and it must exist in all of them. Every other indexable page of the site must still exist in every language of site.json. The words live here rather than in i18n/, because those dictionaries must carry the same keys in all twenty-two languages and the documentation is written in two.
//languages: The languages the documentation is written in. The owner decided on English and Polish (2026-11-24), the two languages the program's window has texts in. The window itself starts in English, so a page in Polish names its buttons and fields in English, the way the reader sees them. The first must be the site's root language.
